evidence.title: Explee — 24/7 AI-agent, that finds clients while you sleep

name: Explee
summary: AI outbound agent that researches your market, writes personalized cold emails and books demos.
description: Give it a domain and Explee researches the market, picks high-intent prospects from a database of 105M+ companies and 536M+ people, writes each a personal email and handles replies and booking. Sending runs through pre-warmed inboxes at $0.04 per email pay-as-you-go, with $30 in free credits; bulk B2B data and AI search are separate products.
contains: AI researches the market and finds high-intent leads from a website URL
writes personalized emails, handles replies and books meetings
sends from pre-warmed inboxes with a 97% inbox rate
pay-as-you-go at $0.04 per email; $30 free credits (~750 emails)
bulk B2B data and AI search add-ons by country
